claims.text: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met on the artifacts themselves: the trip_record EV-TRIP-02806, the gps_trace EV-GPS-02806 and the fare_breakdown EV-FARE-02806 all carry trip TRP-02806, and the trace's first fix (2026-09-11T17:19:44+08:00) is the same instant as the trip_record's started_at / trip_started event, so the three artifacts describe one and the same trip and the identity limb of the rider's burden is discharged without more.

The threshold measurement must be taken from the governing trace figure, not from the rounded trip copy. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern where it disagrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km and forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test. On the governing figure the trip ran 14.84 km against a booked optimal of 14.00 km, an excess of 0.84 km, which is greater than the 0.8 km absolute limb; the rounded 14.8 km carried on the trip_record would give exactly 0.80 km and would not exceed that limb. The trace figure therefore clears the absolute limb by 0.04 km and the rounded figure does not clear it at all.

Honest concession, so that the tribunal is not asked to find what the arithmetic does not support: the excess is 0.84 km on 14.00 km, which is 6.00% of the booked optimal, and POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass. The rider does not contend that the 20% limb is met and does not ask for a distance refund the clause does not produce. What the rider does press is that the governing figure is the trace figure (14.84 km, excess 0.84 km), which clears the absolute limb, and that nothing on this record exculpates the driver for the excess that the trace does measure.

The driver's only account is 'I followed the navigation'. That is a general assertion which names no evidence ID, and no traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02806-01 is MISSING, it carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own issue detail records that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. The chat log EV-CHAT-02806 holds 0 messages, so there is no contemporaneous in-trip explanation either. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight, and under POL-RD-13 an asserted external traffic cause is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else; with that artifact MISSING the comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the driver's explanation neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route.

If the tribunal finds the excess establishes a deviation, the refund is arithmetic and not discretionary, and it is above the de minimis floor: charged_total 21.10; recomputed_fare 20.3920, being (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 18.9) x 1.0, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02806, plus 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 ERP and tolls on the optimal route, plus 0.00 waiting-time fee, less 0.00 promo discount; refund = 0.7080, rounded UP to SGD 0.75 payable. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis threshold, and it is nowhere near 90% of charged_total, so the outcome on that finding would be PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 0.75 rather than NO_ACTION as de minimis, and the ruling must state charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund on separate lines.

No heightened corroboration requirement attaches to this rider, so the claim is to be decided on the artifacts alone: under POL-RD-08 the extra-corroboration condition bites only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer, and on EV-RPROF-02806 those two figures are 0 and 0 respectively. The rider is therefore not a serial claimant against whom the corroboration rule could be turned, and no adverse inference is to be drawn from the profile in place of the trace evidence.

claims.text: The route deviation the rider alleges does not exist on this record. Under POL-RD-01 a deviation is ESTABLISHED only when the excess is greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and both tests must pass. The trace-governed excess here is 0.84 km on a 14.0 km optimal route, which is 6.00% of optimal — barely a third of the 20% the clause demands. The percentage limb fails decisively, and because both limbs are conjunctive the claim fails with it.

The governing measurement is the trace figure, not a rounded copy. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the field that decides the threshold test and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for it. On the governing figure the excess is 14.84 - 14.0 = 0.84 km, and measured against the 20% limb the result is the same: no establishment.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show, citing evidence IDs, an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold. The derived deviation block records excess_km 0.84 against thresholds of 20.0% and 0.8 km, and returns the status 'no deviation'. The first limb of the rider's required showing is therefore not made, the burden never shifts to the driver, and the driver is not obliged to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 or any other exculpatory clause.

No billing-integrity defect rescues the rider's claim either. POL-RD-01 reserves a POL-RD-09(4) correction for a rider whose threshold test fails, but there is no phantom line to correct: the fare breakdown itemises 0.00 ERP and tolls, erp_gantries is empty, and the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is no unmatched charge for the pass-through limb to refund.

The driver's statement to the platform — 'I followed the navigation' — is exactly what the trip record shows. It is a 19.3-minute metered trip on a RYDE_X vehicle with 0 chat messages, no amended pickup or dropoff, no in-app calls and no cancelled leg; the recorded variance is 0.84 km (6.00%), the ordinary lane-change and divided-road margin that POL-RD-01's single numeric gate exists to keep out of the refund system.

This case can be ruled on the trace rather than escalated. The trace is clean for policy purposes as well as for schema purposes: 117 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum consecutive-fix gap of 0.0 seconds. None of POL-RD-07's impairment limbs (a) to (c) is met — no gap over 90 seconds, no 500 m straight-line jump, no sustained interval above 30 seconds — so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and the deviation question is answered, not deferred.

The correct outcome is NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present payment state stands, and it is party-relative: this is a rider-filed dispute, fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so ruling NO_ACTION leaves the charge in place rather than restoring it.

ruling.explanation:
This decides a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02806 (Northpoint City to Blk 420 Woodlands St 41), contested amount SGD 2.00. The charged total was SGD 21.10 and payment_status is CHARGED.

The measurement. The governing figure is the GPS trace EV-GPS-02806: trace_distance_km 14.84 km, not the rounded 14.8 km carried on the trip record EV-TRIP-02806. Against the booked optimal distance of 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02806), the excess is 0.84 km.

The test. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only when the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km absolute. Here 0.84 km / 14.0 km = 6.00% of optimal, far below the 20% limb, so the conjunctive test fails and no deviation is established. The absolute limb passing at 0.84 km does not save the claim, because both limbs must pass. I have taken the excess from the trace figure as POL-RD-01 requires; on the rounded 14.8 km it would be exactly 0.80 km and would not clear the absolute limb at all.

Consequences for the refund arithmetic. With no deviation established, POL-RD-02 does not run, so the recomputed_fare of 20.3920 and the de-minimis/refund figures (0.7080 refund, 0.75 payable) are not applied — that arithmetic was conditional on a finding the trace does not support, and the rider's own advocate conceded the 20% limb. I checked the billing-integrity route independently under POL-RD-09(4), which is available whether or not a deviation exists: the fare breakdown EV-FARE-02806 itemises 0.00 ERP and tolls, erp_gantries is empty, and the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is no phantom or unmatched line to refund.

The trace and escalation. The trace is clean for policy purposes as well as schema purposes: 117 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum consecutive-fix gap of 0.0 seconds. None of POL-RD-07's impairment limbs (a) to (c) is met, so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and no escalation arises.

The driver's explanation. The driver's statement 'I followed the navigation' is an assertion citing no evidence ID, and no traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02806-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own detail records that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. Because no party cited that missing identifier as the artifact behind an exculpatory clause, its absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, and it does not trigger POL-RD-10(5). Under POL-RD-13 the driver's traffic excuse carries no weight, but that does not create a refund either — the case is decided on the trace arithmetic, which already finds no deviation. There is also no contemporaneous in-trip explanation: the chat log EV-CHAT-02806 holds 0 messages.

Outcome. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands. This is a rider-filed dispute, fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0; those are left as they are. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the fare of SGD 21.10 charged on trip TRP-02806 stands. No refund is due to the rider, no payment is due to the driver, and the payment state (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0) is left as it is.

Why there is no deviation. Under POL-RD-01 a route deviation is established only if the excess distance is BOTH more than 20% of the optimal distance AND more than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The governing measurement is the trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02806 = 14.84 km, not the rounded 14.8 km convenience copy on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02806), which POL-RD-01 forbids citing for the threshold test. Against the booked optimal of 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02806) the excess is 0.84 km, i.e. 6.00% of optimal. It clears the 0.8 km limb by 0.04 km (the rounded 14.8 km would give exactly 0.80 km and would not clear it), but it falls far short of the 20% limb. Both limbs must pass, so no deviation is established and POL-RD-01 returns NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised.

Consequently the rider's conditional request for a SGD 0.75 partial refund under POL-RD-02 is refused. The arithmetic is not in dispute — charged_total 21.10, recomputed_fare 20.3920, refund 0.7080 rounded up to 0.75, above the 0.50 de minimis — but POL-RD-02 only runs once a deviation is established under POL-RD-01, and the rider's own case properly concedes that the 20% limb is not met. The claim that the trace figure clears the absolute limb is correct and accepted, but on its own it does not establish a deviation.

No escalation is engaged. The trace is clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 117 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum consecutive-fix gap of 0.0 s, so none of limbs (a)–(c) fires and POL-RD-10(3) is not triggered; this is a case that can be ruled rather than deferred. No charge line is unmatched: ERP and tolls are 0.00, erp_gantries is empty, there is no airport surcharge, no surge uplift, no amended endpoint and no refund already issued, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to correct and POL-RD-10(8) has nothing to catch. POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered by the absent advisory either. The bundle holds EV-ADVIS-02806-01 as a MISSING traffic advisory at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the driver's only account, 'I followed the navigation', names no evidence ID; under POL-RD-13 the driver's uncited traffic assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, and with that artifact absent the comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no artifact, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it, and no escalation follows from it. In any event the driver does not need the excuse: the rider never showed a threshold-meeting excess in the first place.

On the profiles: EV-RPROF-02806 records deviation_claims_60d 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0, so the heightened-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 does not bite and no adverse inference is drawn. No profile field beyond those two citable counters affects this outcome, and POL-GEN-01 has been applied.

Figures used: charged_total 21.10; optimal_distance_km 14.0; trace_distance_km 14.84; excess 0.84 km / 6.00%. The monetary effect is nil, which is below the execution threshold. The ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met on the artifacts themselves: the trip_record EV-TRIP-02806, the gps_trace EV-GPS-02806 and the fare_breakdown EV-FARE-02806 all carry trip TRP-02806, and the trace's first fix (2026-09-11T17:19:44+08:00) is the same instant as the trip_record's started_at / trip_started event, so the three artifacts describe one and the same trip and the identity limb of the rider's burden is discharged without more.

The threshold measurement must be taken from the governing trace figure, not from the rounded trip copy. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern where it disagrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km and forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test. On the governing figure the trip ran 14.84 km against a booked optimal of 14.00 km, an excess of 0.84 km, which is greater than the 0.8 km absolute limb; the rounded 14.8 km carried on the trip_record would give exactly 0.80 km and would not exceed that limb. The trace figure therefore clears the absolute limb by 0.04 km and the rounded figure does not clear it at all.

Honest concession, so that the tribunal is not asked to find what the arithmetic does not support: the excess is 0.84 km on 14.00 km, which is 6.00% of the booked optimal, and POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass. The rider does not contend that the 20% limb is met and does not ask for a distance refund the clause does not produce. What the rider does press is that the governing figure is the trace figure (14.84 km, excess 0.84 km), which clears the absolute limb, and that nothing on this record exculpates the driver for the excess that the trace does measure.

The driver's only account is 'I followed the navigation'. That is a general assertion which names no evidence ID, and no traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02806-01 is MISSING, it carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own issue detail records that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. The chat log EV-CHAT-02806 holds 0 messages, so there is no contemporaneous in-trip explanation either. Under POL-RD-01 a deviation is ESTABLISHED only when the excess is greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and both tests must pass. The trace-governed excess here is 0.84 km on a 14.0 km optimal route, which is 6.00% of optimal — barely a third of the 20% the clause demands. The percentage limb fails decisively, and because both limbs are conjunctive the claim fails with it.

The governing measurement is the trace figure, not a rounded copy. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the field that decides the threshold test and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for it. On the governing figure the excess is 14.84 - 14.0 = 0.84 km, and measured against the 20% limb the result is the same: no establishment.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show, citing evidence IDs, an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold. The derived deviation block records excess_km 0.84 against thresholds of 20.0% and 0.8 km, and returns the status 'no deviation'. The first limb of the rider's required showing is therefore not made, the burden never shifts to the driver, and the driver is not obliged to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 or any other exculpatory clause.

No billing-integrity defect rescues the rider's claim either. POL-RD-01 reserves a POL-RD-09(4) correction for a rider whose threshold test fails, but there is no phantom line to correct: the fare breakdown itemises 0.00 ERP and tolls, erp_gantries is empty, and the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. The trace is clean for policy purposes as well as for schema purposes: 117 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum consecutive-fix gap of 0.0 seconds. None of POL-RD-07's impairment limbs (a) to (c) is met — no gap over 90 seconds, no 500 m straight-line jump, no sustained interval above 30 seconds — so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and the deviation question is answered, not deferred.
